title: Which project and which ticket: screens follow the current project, meeting tabs name their ticket
summary: The PRD, Map, Tickets and + tabs now follow the active project and the title bar names it; Start meeting refuses to open another project's live session and says which one runs; each meeting agent tab is titled with its ticket. 1869 tests green; the missing prototype state went in as the first commit.
friction: C:\wt\in-flight.json is shared with another repository's /dev-next runs (project-morph entries were listed), and the phase 1 stagger counts every other run on the machine, so a Grillo run would skip top candidates for runs that cannot compete for them; this run counted only Grillo runs (k=0)
lessons_learned: With the in-memory store no agent can start, so Start meeting and meeting-tab titles cannot be tried in npm run dev; meeting and agent-tab stories need their screen evidence planned up front (tests, or a fake agent) rather than discovered at the try-out
